how: Fill every 'text' with the translation of 'source': the same meaning in natural pt-BR, short enough to say aloud in the cue's time, as it is both spoken and shown; keep names and numbers. Optional 'emphasis': words to colour, as in fixes.json. Don't change i, start or end.
